classes.reason: The sheet's sign-in code is unchanged and uses the exact data-defined process.env.CSS_DEMO_USERNAME and CSS_DEMO_PASSWORD values, clicks the login button, and then opens the specified `/policies` path. The failed run displayed no policy text or coverage values; the fresh page snapshot showed an unauthenticated welcome page and direct `/policies` navigation redirected to `/login`. The login form was visible. As the user/session procedure specified by the plan is followed, but the application fails to make the policy visible, this confirms an application-level failure rather than a locator problem.
